A still teal forest pool under dense ferns and gnarly arching trunks, quiet dusky blue-green mist; one small cluster of amber fungi as a local light source at far left. Center and right-center 35-65% are uncluttered low-contrast water and haze for real UI. Oculum Rame fatato: confident irregular gouache brushwork, matte old storybook/anime fantasy drawing, restrained soft oil textures, stylized elegant anatomy, not photoreal, no 3D, no smooth AI plastic, no engraved filigree everywhere. Natural forest fully shaded, no visible Sun/Moon/stars, no fairies. No text, no lettering, no logos, no frame, no watermark, no painted UI. Full body and foliage fit safely inside image.
